mapper.sql: capture_id::text AS capture_id, user_id, content, image_storage_key, captured_at, version, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO capture_item (capture_id, user_id, content, image_storage_key, captured_at) VALUES (CAST(#{captureId} AS UUID), #{userId}, #{content}, #{imageStorageKey}, #{capturedAt}) ON CONFLICT (capture_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM capture_item WHERE ORDER BY captured_at DESC, capture_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE capture_item SET content = #{content}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE capture_id = CAST(#{captureId} AS UUID) AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE capture_item SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE capture_id = CAST(#{captureId} AS UUID) AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
